$comment: Known, inherited lint errors that CI tolerates — and only these.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. design-kit was forked from libs/sysop-ui, which has no CI
and whose lint was already red. Wiring a blocking gate over that means a build
that is red on arrival, and a gate that is red for reasons nobody wrote down is
how a gate gets disabled wholesale. Suppressing the errors instead would hide
them. So they are recorded here, by rule and file, with an owner and an exit.
THIS IS A RATCHET, NOT AN EXEMPTION. The gate fails if a count rises, if a new
signature appears, AND if a count falls — a fall means someone fixed something
and the baseline needs tightening, which is a one-line edit. The baseline can
therefore only ever shrink, and it cannot rot silently.
DO NOT ADD TO THIS FILE to get a build green. Adding an entry is adding debt
that someone else pays. Fix the error, or route the decision to the epic lead.

entries.inherited: libs/sysop-ui at aef2dff reports the identical 2 errors at the identical lines on its own pinned plugin 0.5.2, so this is not a regression introduced by the fork
entries.cause: the module co-exports safeParseObject and scalarStr alongside its components
entries.exit: json-payload classifies BASE in the CW-0116 triage, so CW-0125 is touching the file anyway and splits the two helpers out during the move. That removes the error rather than hiding it.
entries.notWidening: the src/components/ui/** react-refresh exemption must NOT be widened to cover this. That exemption is for the shadcn variant-helper co-export pattern (buttonVariants, badgeVariants); these two are plain utilities. Stretching a narrow exemption erodes why it is narrow, and the next case cites this one as precedent.
